13. (Currently amended) A flexible respiratory gas tube arrangement for supplying a respiratory gas to a person, the tube arrangement comprising: a flexible tube; a heater to heat the gas as it is delivered through the tube; a first connector provided to one end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a breathing mask; and a second connector provided to the other end of the tube and adapted to connect the tube with a CPAP device, said second connector including a first portion that provides a respiratory gas passage and a second portion that provides integrated contact elements by which power is supplied to said heater, wherein said contact elements are adapted to be engaged with a power supply provided on the CPAP device for supplying power to said heater, __and wherein each contact element extends generally parallel to a longitudinal axis of the gas passage such that both an electric and pneumatic connection is provided when the connector is connected to the CPAP device.__

14. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising an insulating sheathing body.

15. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the insulating sheathing body is removably attachable to the flexible tube __independently of the first connector and the second connector__.

16. (Cancelled)

17. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein said sheathing body includes a multi-layered design.

18. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the tube is a heatable respiratory gas tube.

19. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 14, wherein the heater is integrated into the tube.

20. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein said second connector further includes a pressure measuring tube connection __separate from said first portion and said second portion__.

21. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, further comprising a respiratory gas humidifier __in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube__.

22. (Currently amended) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is adapted to be connected to a water source via a humidification line __for supplying water to said flexible tube piece__.

23. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 21, wherein said humidifier is in the form of a flexible tube piece disposed between the breathing mask and the respiratory gas tube.

24. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the flexible tube is made from a spirally reinforced plastic material.

25. (Previously presented) The gas tube arrangement according to claim 13, wherein the heater is an electrical resistance heater.
